About Abdullah

I am a Medical Laboratory Sciences professional with a growing focus on genomics, diagnostic innovation, healthcare systems, and the future of laboratory medicine — working at the intersection of clinical practice and applied research.

I.

Genomics & Molecular Diagnostics

Exploring how sequencing and molecular methods reshape clinical decision-making.

II.

Clinical Laboratory Sciences

Grounded in blood banking and histocompatibility / HLA laboratory practice.

III.

Healthcare & Laboratory Innovation

Designing tools and systems that make laboratory operations faster and smarter.

IV.

Healthcare Systems

Studying how diagnostics infrastructure scales across regional health systems.

V.

Professional Community Building

Founding a professional network that connects laboratory specialists across the Gulf region.

Research & Innovation

Where laboratory medicine meets applied engineering.

My work explores how laboratory medicine, genomics, artificial intelligence, and digital health can transform diagnostics and healthcare delivery.

Diagnostic Device

MedNail

An emerging diagnostic concept exploring optical analysis of the nail bed — using imaging and computational methods to investigate clinically relevant biomarkers, including non-invasive SpO2 and hemoglobin estimation.

International Patent — Geneva Exhibition

Selected Projects

Problem. Solution. Impact.

MedNail — Diagnostic Innovation

Problem

Non-invasive biomarker monitoring remains limited in routine and remote diagnostic settings.

Solution

Optical, imaging-based analysis of the nail bed to estimate clinically relevant markers.

Impact

Internationally recognised concept, presented at the Geneva Exhibition of Inventions.

LabOS — Digital Infrastructure

Problem

Laboratory systems operate as disconnected tools rather than one intelligent environment.

Solution

A unifying operating layer connecting automation, analytics, and decision-support.

Impact

A Vision 2030-aligned blueprint for scalable laboratory digital infrastructure.

Blood Bank Automation — AI & Operations

Problem

Manual transfusion workflows constrain turnaround time and inventory precision.

Solution

AI-integrated automation applied to blood bank operations and stock management.

Impact

A working demonstration model built for institutional presentation.

Healthcare Community — Networking & Knowledge

Problem

Laboratory professionals in the Gulf lack a dedicated, high-signal professional network.

Solution

A private, governed community for knowledge exchange and career opportunity.

Impact

A growing regional network of laboratory specialists and researchers.
